variants.definition: Convert RGB to full-range BT.709 YCbCr; preserve target Y; rotate centered (Cb,Cr) by +90 degrees; preserve chroma-vector magnitude before RGB gamut clipping; reconstruct RGB with iterative luminance correction after clipping.

Preserve target BT.709 Y and spatial structure; transfer only CbCr mean/covariance from a deterministic context-only donor using a frozen whitening-colouring transform; reconstruct RGB with iterative luminance correction after clipping.

naturalistic_palette_donors.selection: deterministic stable-hash donor per target from a different environment where possible; target label is never consulted

quality_gate.geometry: no spatial resampling or geometry change is permitted

transformed_domain_extension_if_naturali.fixed_config_retrain: same frozen champion hyperparameters per O/S/T/ST on naturalistic-counterfactual train, then naturalistic-counterfactual test
transformed_domain_extension_if_naturali.hpo: optional cleaned/transformed-domain HPO using transformed training population only; transformed test remains sealed until configuration freeze

interpretation.naturalistic_counterfactual_drop: stronger evidence that chromatic cues materially influence the frozen model
